# A bill overpaid out of a split parked in another currency.
#
# The overpayment carve on the bill side. 120.00 USD left the bank against a
# bill owing 100.00, so 20.00 is over — and the carve would read the named
# split's own figure to divide it, which is 166.80 CAD of scaffolding. Both
# halves would come out of a number that means nothing.
#
# The refusal explains that the split's figure "stood in for the ..." and
# names the record's own account, which for a bill is the **payable**.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal naming the payable, with the entry
# untouched.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
bill "BILL-USD-001"
  vendor_id: "V-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Parts"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
    memo: "Bill BILL-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-04-06
    amount: 120
    account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
    txn_guid: "2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c5f6a7b8c9d0e1a"
    txn_split_guid: "4c5d6e7f8a9b0c5f6a7b8c9d0e1a2b3c"
